title: WoW's Game Director Was a Lawyer Before He Built Raids
hook: Ion Hazzikostas spent several years as a practicing attorney, then quit in 2008 to design boss fights at Blizzard. By 2016 he was running all of World of Warcraft. Would you trade a law career for Azeroth?
script: Did you know the man running World of Warcraft used to be a lawyer? Ion Hazzikostas spent several years as a practicing attorney at a law firm. That was his day job, and raiding was what he did after work. By night he was a raid leader in Elitist Jerks, one of the most famous guilds in the game. In 2008 he left the law behind and joined Blizzard as a game designer. His new job was building boss encounters, the very fights he used to lead his guild through. Blizzard liked what it saw in a designer who had led real raids. Over the next few years he worked his way up through the World of Warcraft design team. Then in October 2016, Blizzard named him game director of the whole game. He has held that job ever since, more than a decade now. He still fronts the expansion reveals and the big systems changes. Players know him from the developer updates where he walks through every major change. So the next time a raid boss wipes your group, remember who designed it. It was someone who practiced law before he ever practiced game design. Blizzard hired a player who understood raids from the inside, and he ended up running the game. Would you trade a law career for Azeroth? Follow for more gaming history.
